title: RL — Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) Explained
summary: This paper explains Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), a reinforcement learning algorithm that addresses convergence problems in policy gradient methods while remaining simpler to implement than natural policy gradient approaches. PPO uses a penalty-based constraint formulation instead of hard constraints, allowing first-order optimization methods like gradient descent to be effective. The explanation covers fundamental concepts including the Minorize-Maximization algorithm, line search methods, trust regions, and KL-divergence constraints that limit policy changes during optimization.
